titulo: Quiz — The ticket that validates itself, and the one that does not
subtitulo: Buy, check the rule, find the platform
introPt: A traveller buys a regional ticket and works out which validation rule applies.
cenario: At the station, six minutes before departure.

dialogo.es: Un biglietto per Firenze, per favore.

dialogo.pt: Do I have to validate the ticket?

dialogo.es: Sì, quello di carta sì. Alla macchinetta verde.
dialogo.pt: Yes, the paper one yes. At the little green machine.

perguntas.pergunta: When does a Biglietto Digitale Regionale validate?
opcoes: When you scan it at the machine
Automatically, at the scheduled departure time you chose
perguntas.explica: No manual check-in — and after it auto-activates it can no longer be moved.

perguntas.pergunta: What happens with an unstamped paper regional ticket?
opcoes: A fine from €50 plus the price of the ticket
You buy a new one on board at no extra cost
perguntas.explica: Reducible if paid within five days at a Trenitalia office.
The number is on the screen — you do not produce it from memory.

perguntas.pergunta: Your phone battery dies before inspection. What is your position?
opcoes: Fine, the ticket is registered in the system
You may be treated as travelling without a valid ticket
The inspector will look you up by name
perguntas.explica: The QR is the ticket — it has to be displayable.

perguntas.pergunta: Why does this part carry a short review date?
opcoes: Italian regional ticketing is mid-transition and the rule moved recently
perguntas.explica: Check the operator's own page before a trip rather than trusting old advice.
